page_title: PIS 0-3 COM | Pisa v Como 06/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' 0 - 3 Goal! Anastasios Douvikas (Como) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Adrian Semper into the bottom left corner.
90+6' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+5' The foul by Francesco Coppola (Pisa) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Luca Pairetto.

90+5' Francesco Coppola (Pisa) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY! One of the players from Como is about to take a penalty kick.
90+4' Malthe Hojholt (Pisa) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Luca Pairetto no option but to blow his whistle.
90+2' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa).
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jesus Rodriguez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Stefan Posch (Como).
88' Cesc Fabregas makes a half-time substitution. Sergi Roberto comes on in place of Nico Paz (Como).
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Malthe Hojholt (Pisa) comes onto the pitch so that Antonio Caracciolo can be given a rest.
85' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the left post, but Jean Butez leaps out to thwart his attempt.
85' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) is going to take the penalty!
84' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Pisa!
83' There's a break in play and referee Luca Pairetto must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Pisa using VAR. This could be interesting!
82' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle after Maxence Caqueret (Como) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Pisa have been awarded a penalty kick!
80' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
78' The referee signals a substitution. Martin Baturina (Como) is brought on as a substitute for Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn.
77' A substitution has been made. Michel Aebischer is replaced by Tomas Esteves (Pisa).
77' Here is a change. Gabriele Piccinini is going off and Alberto Gilardino gives the last tactical orders to Lorran (Pisa).
76' 0 - 2 Anastasios Douvikas (Como) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom left corner. Magnificent finish!
73' The foul by Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) was seen by Luca Pairetto who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
71' Adrian Semper displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Anastasios Douvikas (Como) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
68' 0 - 1 Maximo Perrone (Como) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. Although the shot low to the middle of the goal isn't very precise, it ends up in the net.
67' Maxence Caqueret (Como) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
64' Substitution. Lucas Da Cunha walks off the pitch and Maxence Caqueret (Como) comes on as a substitute.
64' Substitution. Ivan Smolcic is replaced by Mergim Vojvoda (Como).
64' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute Matteo Tramoni and he is replaced by Stefano Moreo (Pisa).
63' Marius Marin will be replaced by Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa).
63' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle and it's M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
62' The resulting corner from Jesus Rodriguez (Como) is cleared by the defence.
61' Looks like Idrissa Toure (Pisa) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

60' Nico Paz (Como) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Adrian Semper. The ball goes out of play. Como are awarded a corner kick.
59' Nico Paz (Como) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
57' The Como players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

54' Jacobo Ramon (Como) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
54' Nico Paz (Como) will take the corner.
53' Alex Valle (Como) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball goes out for a corner. Como can continue in their attacking effort.
53' The corner from Michel Aebischer (Pisa) is intercepted by the defence.

52' Great save! Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Jean Butez. The ball goes behind for a corner. Pisa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
50' The ball is cleared after Idrissa Toure (Pisa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
48' Samuele Angori (Pisa) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
47' Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot, but is thwarted by a decent save from Jean Butez.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) makes a terrific run to get on the end of the free kick and powers a header just wide of the right post from close in.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Jacobo Ramon (Como) sees a yellow card from Luca Pairetto after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
44' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
43' Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
41' A fine solo run by M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies well wide of the left post.
40' Marius Marin (Pisa) is able to continue to play.
40' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) is penalised for a foul. Luca Pairetto had a clear view and blows his whistle.
39' Marius Marin (Pisa) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
38' Nico Paz (Como) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
35' The linesman signals that M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
34' Samuele Angori (Pisa) tries to find M'Bala Nzola, but he puts too much power on the pass.

31' Nico Paz (Como) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Adrian Semper pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
27' Francesco Coppola (Pisa) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
24' Luca Pairetto shows the yellow card to Lucas Da Cunha (Como) for a heavy challenge.
24' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Idrissa Toure (Pisa).
22' A yellow card for a tackle by Michel Aebischer (Pisa). Luca Pairetto doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
20' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
20' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the right post.
18' Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
17' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
15' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is penalised for holding. Luca Pairetto signals a set piece.
12' Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
10' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
9' Como quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
9' Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Como win a corner.
8' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
7' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Como.
4' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Nico Paz (Como) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Adrian Semper easily catches the ball.
4' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
3' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Como get a corner.
1' The match has just started.
Como will kick the game off.
Luca Pairetto is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
